description: Core concepts in algebra including equations, functions, and systems

basic_operations.order_of_operations: PEMDAS/BODMAS: Parentheses/Brackets, Exponents/Orders, Multiplication, Division, Addition, Subtraction

properties.commutative: a + b = b + a; a × b = b × a

expressions_and_equations.expression: Combination of variables, numbers, operations; no equals sign
expressions_and_equations.equation: Two expressions set equal; has solution(s)
expressions_and_equations.solving_linear: Isolate variable by doing same operation to both sides

functions.definition: Relation where each input has exactly one output
functions.notation: f(x); x is the input, f(x) is the output
functions.linear: f(x) = mx + b; m = slope, b = y-intercept
functions.logarithmic: Inverse of exponential; log_b(x) = y means b^y = x
functions.composition: f(g(x)); apply g first, then f

graphing.slope: m = (y₂ - y₁) / (x₂ - x₁); rise over run
graphing.vertex: Turning point of a parabola; x = -b/2a for y = ax² + bx + c

systems_of_equations.substitution: Solve one equation for a variable, substitute into the other
systems_of_equations.elimination: Multiply equations to make coefficients opposite; add to eliminate a variable

types_of_solutions.infinite: Same line; every point is a solution

factoring.gcf: Greatest Common Factor: ax + ay = a(x + y)

inequalities.notation: < less than, > greater than, ≤ less or equal, ≥ greater or equal
inequalities.solving: Same as equations; reverse inequality sign when multiplying/dividing by negative
